briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.1%), showing no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. With only $189.29 in cash — below our $500 deployment threshold — and all 7 existing positions still healthy, we held everything and made no new trades.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Consolidation happens when a market moves sideways or drifts slightly in either direction without a clear trend, often after a period of gains. It's a normal pause where investors wait for new information before committing more capital, which is why holding cash and existing positions can be the right call rather than forcing new trades.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 盤整（Consolidation）是指市場在沒有明顯趨勢的情況下橫盤或小幅波動，通常發生在一段漲勢之後。這是投資人在等待新訊息前的正常暫歇期，因此在這種時候持有現金與現有部位、而非勉強進場交易，往往才是正確的做法。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.1%. There was no dominant catalyst driving the move, consistent with a low-conviction, consolidative session rather than a genuine shift in sentiment. Days like this often reflect investors digesting recent gains before the next directional trigger emerges.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數皆小幅下跌，走勢方向不明：納斯達克下跌0.3%，標普500下跌0.1%。市場並無明顯主導因素，較像是投資人在消化近期漲幅後的整理格局，而非情緒出現實質轉向。這類交易日通常需要等待下一個明確訊號才會出現方向性突破。
